outcome: anthropometric measurements (body weight, body length, chest girth)
cohort: Neonates who received an abdominal ultrasonogram within seven days of life were recruited.
finding: Neonatal adrenal hemorrhage (NAH) occurred in 0.4% of neonates, was more frequent in heavier neonates, and was associated with neonatal jaundice and spontaneous resolution within 7 months.
mod_finding: Infants with NAH tended to be delivered via vaginal delivery with vacuum-extraction rather than cesarean section.
